title: Winter on the Black Sea
subtitle: A few winter days in Odessa on the edge of the Black Sea.
introTitle: Through London and Istanbul to Odessa
story: I left Dallas–Fort Worth on December 8, traveling through London and Istanbul before reaching Odessa on the Black Sea. A few winter days there made for a very different kind of trip, before returning home the same way on December 13.
